# Emdad Home Furniture

Emdad Home Furniture designs and manufactures custom home furniture and kitchens in the UAE.

## Core Services

- Custom home furniture
- Made-to-measure kitchens
- Bedroom furniture
- Living room furniture and sofas
- Dining room furniture
- Cabinets, TV units, and storage
- Delivery and installation

## Short Description

Emdad Home Furniture is a UAE-based furniture manufacturer specializing in made-to-measure bedrooms, living rooms, dining rooms, kitchens, cabinets, and custom furniture, with material selection, delivery, and installation support.
